english.heading: Seeds and Seed Sovereignty
body: Seed is where the next season begins.
When your household can save, store and share good seed, it carries more than a crop forward. It also carries the freedom to choose.
In this lesson, you will follow seed from the parent plant to the packet, the germination test and a neighbour’s hand.
Think about the crops in your area. Which ones do you already save seed from? Which seed do you buy? Which seed do you exchange?
Try to name at least one crop whose seed is already being saved in your area.

body.text: Imbewu yeyona ndawo isizini elandelayo eqala kuyo.
Xa umzi wakho unokulondoloza, ugcine yaye wabelane ngembewu entle, uthwala ngaphezu kwesivuno. Uthwala nenkululeko yokukhetha.
Kwesi sifundo, uya kulandela imbewu isuka kwisityalo somzali ukuya kwipakethi, kuvavanyo lokuhluma nasesandleni somamelwane.
Cinga ngezityalo zendawo yakho. Zeziphi ozilondoloza imbewu zazo kwangoku? Yeyiphi imbewu oyithengayo? Yeyiphi imbewu oyitshintshisanayo?
Zama ukuchaza isityalo esinye ubuncinane esele imbewu yaso ilondolozwa kwindawo yakho.

english.heading: Why Saving Seed Matters
body: Saving seed does not mean rejecting all bought seed. It means building practical choices.
Each crop you learn to save well removes one repeated purchase. It also begins a local record of what performs well in your soil and your season.
Think about the seed you buy again and again. Which repeated seed purchase costs your household the most each year?
Choose one crop from your planting list. Make it your practical starting point for seed saving. Do not try to save everything at once.

body.text: Ukulondoloza imbewu akuthethi ukwala yonke imbewu ethengiweyo. Kuthetha ukwakha ukhetho olusebenzayo.
Isityalo ngasinye ofunda ukusilondoloza kakuhle sisusa ukuthenga okunye okuphindaphindwayo. Siqala nerekhodi lasekuhlaleni lokuba yintoni esebenza kakuhle emhlabeni wakho nakwisizini yakho.
Cinga ngembewu oyithenga kwakhona nakwakhona. Kukuthenga imbewu kweyiphi okuphindaphindwayo okubiza umzi wakho kakhulu ngonyaka?
Khetha isityalo esinye kuluhlu lwakho lokutyala. Yenza sibe yindawo yakho yokuqala esebenzayo yokulondoloza imbewu. Musa ukuzama ukulondoloza yonke into ngexesha elinye.

english.heading: Learning Outcomes
body: This lesson ends with a working seed store, not a list of facts.
You will make four decisions.
What will you save?
How will you process it?
How will you protect it?
And how will you know it is still alive before you depend on it?
Which of these four decisions is least familiar to you?
Say them again in your own words: select, process, protect and verify.

body.text: Esi sifundo siphelela kwindawo yokugcina imbewu esebenzayo, hayi kuluhlu lweenyani.
Uya kwenza izigqibo ezine.
Uya kulondoloza ntoni?
Uya kuyilungisa njani?
Uya kuyikhusela njani?
Kwaye uya kwazi njani ukuba isaphila phambi kokuba uthembele kuyo?
Sesiphi kwezi zigqibo zine esingaqhelekanga kuwe kakhulu?
Zibuye uzithethe ngamazwi akho: khetha, lungisa, khusela kwaye qinisekisa.

english.heading: Open-Pollinated Seed and F1 Seed
body: Open-pollinated seed is not magic.
A stable variety can produce similar generations when it is properly isolated or self-pollinated.
F1 seed usually remains alive. But the next generation separates into different combinations of the parent traits.
The problem is unpredictability, not failure to germinate.
Think about one small bed on your own plot. Why could unpredictable plants be a risk when space is limited?
If you have seed packets, check whether they are marked open-pollinated or F1. Which would you choose for saving dependable seed?
Remember: the next F1 generation varies. It does not automatically die.

body.text: Akukho mlingo kwimbewu ye-open-pollinated.
Uhlobo oluzinzileyo lunokuvelisa izizukulwana ezifanayo xa lwahlulwe ngokufanelekileyo okanye luyazi-pollinate ngokwalo.
Imbewu ye-F1 ihlala iphila. Kodwa isizukulwana esilandelayo sahlukana saba ngamadibaniselwano ahlukeneyo eempawu zabazali.
Ingxaki kukungalindeleki, hayi ukungahlumi.
Cinga ngebhedi encinci enye kwindawo yakho. Kutheni izityalo ezingalindelekanga zinokuba yingozi xa indawo incinci?
Ukuba unamapakethi embewu, jonga ukuba aphawulwe ukuba yi-open-pollinated okanye yi-F1. Yeyiphi onokuyikhetha ukulondoloza imbewu enokuthenjwa?
Khumbula: isizukulwana se-F1 esilandelayo siyahluka. Asifi ngokuzenzekelayo.

english.heading: Watch: Open-Pollinated Seed and F1 Seed
body: Watch both sides.
Both kinds of seed germinate.
Open-pollinated seed produces similar plants when the variety is stable and pollination is properly managed.
Seed saved from an F1 plant also germinates. But its next generation varies. Some plants may be tall. Others may be short. Their vigour and yield may differ.
Ask yourself what this means when choosing seed to save.
If you understand the difference, you can explain it in one sentence: both germinate, but the next F1 generation is unpredictable.

body.text: Bukela macala omabini.
Zombini iintlobo zembewu ziyahluma.
Imbewu ye-open-pollinated ivelisa izityalo ezifanayo xa uhlobo luzinzile kwaye i-pollination ilawulwa ngokufanelekileyo.
Imbewu elondolozwe kwisityalo se-F1 nayo iyahluma. Kodwa isizukulwana sayo esilandelayo siyahluka. Ezinye izityalo zinokuba mde. Ezinye zibe mfutshane. Amandla azo nesivuno sazo zinokwahluka.
Zibuze ukuba oku kuthetha ntoni xa ukhetha imbewu eza kulondolozwa.
Ukuba uyawuqonda umahluko, unokuwuchaza ngesivakalisi esinye: zombini ziyahluma, kodwa isizukulwana se-F1 esilandelayo asilindelekanga.

english.heading: Seed Sovereignty
body: Seed sovereignty does not live in a slogan.
It lives in a dry packet, a written record and knowledge of how the seed behaves.
Your household begins it. Neighbours extend it. The seasons make the local seed collection more useful.
Which seed does your household already save best?
Draw a small map of the homes near you. Beside each home, write one crop that household could bring to a seed exchange.
Sovereignty needs three things: usable seed, written information and exchange.

body.text: Ulawulo lwembewu alubonakali kwisiqubulo.
Lubonakala kwipakethi eyomileyo, kwirekhodi ebhaliweyo nasekwazini indlela imbewu eziphethe ngayo.
Umzi wakho uyaluqala. Abamelwane bayaluyandisa. Amaxesha onyaka enza ingqokelela yembewu yasekuhlaleni ibe luncedo ngakumbi.
Yeyiphi imbewu umzi wakho osele uyilondoloza kakuhle kakhulu?
Zoba imephu encinci yemizi ekufutshane nawe. Ecaleni komzi ngamnye, bhala isityalo esinye loo mzi onokusizisa ekutshintshisaneni ngembewu.
Ulawulo lufuna izinto ezintathu: imbewu enokusetyenziswa, ulwazi olubhaliweyo nokutshintshisana.

english.heading: Watch: Household Seed Network
body: Well-saved seed becomes more powerful when it is known and shared.
Watch one household begin by saving seed well from one crop. Dry seed goes into clean packets. Some packets move to neighbouring homes. The neighbours share different seed in return.
By the end, each household holds more varieties than it had before.
Think about which seed you could share and which seed you might receive from a neighbour. Seed moves. Knowledge and trust must move with it.

body.text: Imbewu elondolozwe kakuhle iba namandla ngakumbi xa yaziwa kwaye yabelwana ngayo.

Bukela umzi omnye uqala ngokulondoloza kakuhle imbewu yesityalo esinye. Imbewu eyomileyo ingena kumapakethi acocekileyo. Amanye amapakethi aya kwimizi ekufutshane. Abamelwane babelana ngembewu eyahlukileyo ngokubuyisela.
Ekupheleni, umzi ngamnye uphethe iintlobo ezininzi kunangaphambili.
Cinga ngembewu onokwabelana ngayo nembewu onokuyamkela kumamelwane. Imbewu iyahamba. Ulwazi nokuthembana kufuneka kuhambe nayo.

english.heading: Select Several Parent Plants
body: The largest fruit is not always the best seed parent.
Look at the whole plant.
Was it healthy?
Did it mature at the right time?
Was it true to type?
Save from several good plants, especially in cross-pollinated crops. This prevents the next generation from coming from only one parent.
What would make you reject a seed plant even if its fruit were large?
Go to your own plot. Point out the plants you would select and the plants you would reject. Choose several healthy, true-to-type plants. Reject diseased plants and those that are not true to type.

body.text: Isiqhamo esikhulu kakhulu asisoloko singumzali olungileyo wembewu.
Jonga isityalo sonke.
Sasinempilo?
Sasivuthwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo?
Sasifana nohlobo lwaso?
Londoloza kwizityalo ezininzi ezilungileyo, ngakumbi kwizityalo ezixubanayo (cross-pollinated). Oku kuthintela isizukulwana esilandelayo ekuveleni kumzali omnye kuphela.
Yintoni enokukwenza uwale isityalo sembewu nokuba isiqhamo saso sikhulu?
Yiya kwindawo yakho. Khomba izityalo ongazikhetha nezo ongazilahla. Khetha izityalo ezininzi ezinempilo ezifana nohlobo lwazo. Wala izityalo ezinesifo neezo zingafaniyo nohlobo lwazo.

english.heading: Control Pollination
body: Some crops mostly self-pollinate. A small garden can therefore keep the variety similar.
Crops pollinated by wind or insects can cross over long distances.
The distance needed depends on the crop, the place and the purpose of the seed. Do not promise varietal purity until you have checked the crop.
How can you separate two varieties without using distance?
You can plant them at different times so they do not flower together. You can also control pollination by hand or with covers.
Remember the three tools: distance, flowering time or controlled pollination.

body.text: Ezinye izityalo ubukhulu bazo ziyazi-pollinate ngokwazo. Ke igadi encinci inokugcina uhlobo lufana.
Izityalo eziphiwa uthuli lwentyatyambo ngumoya okanye ngeenambuzane zinokuxubana ngomgama omde.
Umgama odingekayo uxhomekeke kwisityalo, kwindawo nakwinjongo yembewu. Musa ukuthembisa ukuhlambuluka kohlobo de uhlole isityalo.
Ungazahlula njani iintlobo ezimbini ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umgama?
Unokuzityala ngamaxesha ahlukeneyo ukuze zingatyatyambi kunye. Unokulawula i-pollination nangesandla okanye usebenzise izigqubuthelo.
Khumbula izixhobo ezintathu: umgama, ixesha lokutyatyamba okanye i-pollination elawulwayo.

english.heading: Watch: Self-Pollination and Crossing
body: Follow the path of the pollen.
In self-pollination, pollen moves within one flower from the part that produces it to the part that receives it. This often helps the variety remain similar.
In a maize field, wind carries pollen from the tassels to the silks. If two varieties are close together and flower at the same time, they can cross.
Think about how distance or different flowering times could prevent that on your own plot.

body.text: Landela indlela uthuli lwentyatyambo oluhamba ngayo.
Kwi-self-pollination, uthuli lwentyatyambo luhamba ngaphakathi kwentyatyambo enye lusuka kwinxalenye eluvelisayo lusiya kwinxalenye eluthabathayo. Oku kudla ngokunceda uhlobo lwahlale lufana.

Kwintsimi yombona, umoya uthwala uthuli lwentyatyambo usuka kwii-tassel (iintyatyambo ezisentloko yombona) ukuya kwii-silk (imicu ephuma kwikhoba). Ukuba iintlobo ezimbini zikufutshane zaza zatyatyamba ngaxeshanye, zinokuxubana.
Cinga ukuba umgama okanye amaxesha ahlukeneyo okutyatyamba anokuyithintela njani loo nto kwindawo yakho.

english.heading: Dry and Wet Processing
body: There are two broad ways to process seed.
Dry seed matures in a pod, head or cob. It is collected when fully mature.
Seed inside a fleshy fruit must first be separated from the flesh.
Brief fermentation is especially useful for tomato seed. It is not a rule for every wet-seeded crop.
Think about the crops in your area. Which fit the dry method? Which fit the wet method?
If you have seed or fruit nearby, sort the examples into these two types. Explain the difference by describing what the seed is like at harvest.

body.text: Zimbini iindlela ezinkulu zokulungisa imbewu.
Imbewu eyomileyo ivuthela kwipodi, entlokweni okanye kwikhoba. Iqokelelwa xa ivuthwe ngokupheleleyo.
Imbewu esesiqhamweni esinenyama kufuneka kuqala wahlulwe kwinyama.
Ukuvundiswa okufutshane (fermentation) kuluncedo ngokukodwa kwimbewu yetumato. Asisiso umgaqo kuzo zonke izityalo ezineembewu ezimanzi.
Cinga ngezityalo zendawo yakho. Zeziphi ezilungele indlela eyomileyo? Zeziphi ezilungele indlela emanzi?
Ukuba unembewu okanye iziqhamo ekufutshane, zihlele kwezi ntlobo zimbini. Chaza umahluko ngokuchaza ukuba imbewu injani ngexesha lokuvuna.

english.heading: Process Dry Seed
body: Leave dry-seeded crops on the plant until the seed is fully mature.
Collect it before weather, birds or bursting pods take the harvest.
Remove chaff and damaged seed.
Then spread the clean seed in a single layer in moving air and shade.
What tells you that dry seed is mature enough to collect?
If you have a dry pod or seed head, handle it. Listen for the seed. Compare green, flexible plant material with brown, brittle material.
Wait for maturity. For final drying, use shade and airflow.

body.text: Shiya izityalo ezineembewu ezomileyo esityalweni de imbewu ivuthwe ngokupheleleyo.
Yiqokelele phambi kokuba imozulu, iintaka okanye iipodi ezibhazukayo zithathe isivuno.
Susa i-chaff nembewu eyonakeleyo.
Emva koko yolula imbewu ecocekileyo ibe ngumgangatho omnye emoyeni ohambayo nasemthunzini.
Yintoni ekuxelela ukuba imbewu eyomileyo ivuthe ngokwaneleyo ukuba iqokelelwe?
Ukuba unepodi eyomileyo okanye intloko yembewu, yibambe. Mamela imbewu. Thelekisa into eluhlaza, ethambileyo nento ezintsundu, eqhekekayo.
Linda ukuvuthwa. Ekomiseni kokugqibela, sebenzisa umthunzi nomoya ohambayo.

english.heading: Watch: Dry Processing
body: Allow the seed to mature on the plant before collecting it.
Watch how it is collected once mature. Chaff and debris are removed. Damaged seed is taken out.
The clean seed is then spread in a single layer in moving air and shade.
Follow the steps in order: mature, collect, clean, dry.
Think about where you could carry out each part of this process.

body.text: Vumela imbewu ivuthe esityalweni phambi kokuyiqokelela.
Bukela indlela eqokelelwa ngayo xa sele ivuthile. I-chaff nenkunkuma ziyasuswa. Imbewu eyonakeleyo iyakhutshwa.
Imbewu ecocekileyo iyolulwa ibe ngumgangatho omnye emoyeni ohambayo nasemthunzini.
Landela amanyathelo ngokulandelelana: vuthwa, qokelela, coca, yomisa.
Cinga ukuba ungalenza phi icandelo ngalinye lale nkqubo.

english.heading: Wet Processing for Tomato Seed
body: Scoop tomato seed and flesh into a clean jar with a little water.
Leave it open or loosely covered. Keep it out of direct sun.
After two to three days, a light film and a sour smell may appear.
Rinse promptly. Remove debris. Then spread the clean seed thinly to dry.
Do not seal an actively fermenting jar.
Think about the signs that tell you the process has begun. Also think about signs that would make you discard the batch.
Find a jar, a sieve and a drying plate. When you are ready, start a small batch. Remember the order: scoop, ferment briefly, rinse and dry completely.

body.text: Khupha imbewu yetumato nenyama yayo uyibeke kwingqayi ecocekileyo enamanzi amancinane.
Yishiye ivulekile okanye igqunywe ngokukhululekileyo. Yigcine ingekho elangeni eliqinileyo.
Emva kweentsuku ezimbini ukuya kwezintathu, kusenokubonakala ulwelwe olukhanyayo nevumba elimuncu.
Hlambulula ngokukhawuleza. Susa inkunkuma. Emva koko yolula imbewu ecocekileyo ngokubhityileyo ukuze yome.
Musa ukuvala ingqayi esavundisayo.
Cinga ngemiqondiso ekuxelela ukuba inkqubo iqalile. Cinga nangemiqondiso eyakwenza ulahle iqela.
Fumana ingqayi, isihluzo nepleyiti yokomisa. Xa sele ukulungele, qala iqela elincinci. Khumbula ucwangco: khupha, vundisa ixesha elifutshane, hlambulula uze uyomise ngokupheleleyo.

english.heading: Watch: Wet Processing for Tomato Seed
body: Watch the whole process in order.
A ripe tomato is opened. The seed and gel are scooped into a clean jar. Only a little water is added.
The jar is left open or loosely covered for two to three days.
When a light film and sour smell appear, the contents are poured through a sieve. The seed is rinsed until it is clean.
Finally, the seed is spread in a single layer in the shade until completely dry.
Repeat the steps to yourself: scoop, ferment briefly, rinse, dry completely.

body.text: Bukela inkqubo yonke ngokulandelelana.
Itumato evuthiweyo iyavulwa. Imbewu nejeli zikhutshelwa kwingqayi ecocekileyo. Kongezwa amanzi amancinane kuphela.
Ingqayi ishiywa ivulekile okanye igqunywe ngokukhululekileyo iintsuku ezimbini ukuya kwezintathu.
Xa kubonakala ulwelwe olukhanyayo nevumba elimuncu, okuphakathi kuyathululelwa kwisihluzo. Imbewu iyahlanjululwa de icoceke.
Ekugqibeleni, imbewu iyolulwa ibe ngumgangatho omnye emthunzini de yome ngokupheleleyo.
Zibuyisele amanyathelo: khupha, vundisa ixesha elifutshane, hlambulula, yomisa ngokupheleleyo.

english.heading: Practical Activity
body: This is where the lesson leaves the screen and reaches your hands.
Start one real batch of wet-processed seed.
Use one ripe, healthy fruit, a clean jar, a spoon, a little water, a sieve and a drying plate.
Put the seed, flesh and a little water into the jar. Add a label with the date.
You will look after this jar after the lesson. Decide now when you will inspect it, when you will rinse it and when you will dry the seed.
Your jar needs a date and a return plan. Write down the date when you will inspect it after two days.

body.text: Apha isifundo siyishiya isikrini sifike ezandleni zakho.
Qalisa iqela lenene elinye lembewu elungiswa ngokumanzi.
Sebenzisa isiqhamo esinye esivuthiweyo nesinempilo, ingqayi ecocekileyo, icephe, amanzi amancinane, isihluzo nepleyiti yokomisa.
Beka imbewu, inyama namanzi amancinane kwingqayi. Ncamathisela ileyibhile enomhla.
Uya kuyikhathalela le ngqayi emva kwesifundo. Nqumla ngoku ukuba uya kuyihlola nini, uya kuyihlambulula nini kwaye uya kuyomisa nini imbewu.
Ingqayi yakho ifuna umhla nesicwangciso sokubuya. Bhala phantsi umhla oya kuyihlola ngawo emva kweentsuku ezimbini.

english.heading: Dry First, Seal Later
body: Drying is not a decorative final step.
Moist seed keeps breathing. It can heat, rot or die in storage.
Use shade, moving air and time.
Seal seed only when you are sure it is dry.
Which place in your home has shade and airflow, but is protected from rain and cooking steam?
Choose one safe drying place. Then identify one unsafe place.
Repeat this to check your understanding: dry first, seal later.

body.text: Ukomisa asiyonyathelo lokuhombisa lokugqibela.
Imbewu emanzi iyaqhubeka iphefumla. Inokufudumala, ibole okanye ife ekugcinweni.
Sebenzisa umthunzi, umoya ohambayo nexesha.
Vala imbewu kuphela xa uqinisekile ukuba yomile.
Yeyiphi indawo ekhayeni lakho enomthunzi nomoya, kodwa ekhuselekileyo emvuleni nasemhwambini wokupheka?
Khetha indawo enye yokomisa ekhuselekileyo. Emva koko chonga indawo enye engekhuselekanga.
Phinda oku ukujonga ukuqonda kwakho: yomisa kuqala, vala kamva.

english.heading: Protect Seed from Heat, Light and Moisture
body: Paper packets breathe and organise seed. But they are not enough in a humid climate.
Once the seed is completely dry, place the labelled packets inside a sealed, moisture-proof container. If available, include a food-safe desiccant.
Keep the container as cool and dark as possible in your home.
Which room or cupboard in your home stays coolest and driest?
Compare a paper envelope on its own with an envelope inside a sealed container.
Safe storage has two layers: a labelled paper packet inside a dry, sealed container.

body.text: Amapakethi ephepha ayaphefumla kwaye ahlela imbewu. Kodwa akonelanga kwimozulu enokufuma.

Ekubeni imbewu yomile ngokupheleleyo, beka amapakethi abhalwe amagama ngaphakathi kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo, esikhusela ekufumeni. Ukuba unayo, quka i-desiccant (into ebamba ukufuma) ekhuselekileyo ekutyeni.
Gcina isikhongozeli sipholile kwaye simnyama kangangoko kunokwenzeka ekhayeni lakho.
Liliphi igumbi okanye ikhabhathi ekhayeni lakho elihlala lipholile lize lome kakhulu?
Thelekisa imvulophu yephepha yodwa nemvulophu ngaphakathi kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo.
Ukugcina okukhuselekileyo kunezinqanaba ezimbini: ipakethi yephepha ebhalwe igama ngaphakathi kwisikhongozeli esomileyo, esivaliweyo.

english.heading: Label Every Packet
body: Storage protects the seed physically. Written information protects its meaning.
The packet must tell the next person what crop it is.
It must give the variety or local name.
It must say when the seed was saved and where it came from.
Which local names could be lost if you write only the crop name?
Take a blank packet. Practise writing the four pieces of information: crop, variety or local name, date and source.
Check again that all four are present.

body.text: Ukugcina kukhusela imbewu ngokwasemzimbeni. Ulwazi olubhaliweyo lukhusela intsingiselo yayo.
Ipakethi kufuneka ixelele umntu olandelayo ukuba sisityalo esiyintoni.
Kufuneka inike igama loluhlobo okanye igama lasekuhlaleni.
Kufuneka ithi imbewu yalondolozwa nini nokuba ivela phi.
Ngawaphi amagama asekuhlaleni anokulahleka ukuba ubhala kuphela igama lesityalo?
Thatha ipakethi engenanto. Zilolonge ukubhala iinxalenye ezine zolwazi: isityalo, uhlobo okanye igama lasekuhlaleni, umhla nomthombo.
Jonga kwakhona ukuba zonke ezine zikhona.

english.heading: Ten-Seed Germination Test
body: A seed packet can look perfect even when the seed is losing life.
Ten seeds make the calculation easy.
Keep them warm and moist. Do not submerge them in water.
Then count the normal seedlings.
Six out of ten is about sixty percent. That tells you to sow more heavily, use the seed only as a trial, or replace it.
If eight seeds out of ten germinate, what percentage is that?
The answer is eighty percent.
Start a ten-seed test with an old packet. Write down the date and the day when you will count.

body.text: Ipakethi yembewu inokubonakala igqibelele nokuba imbewu iphulukana nobomi.
Iimbewu ezilishumi zenza ukubala kube lula.
Zigcine zifudumele zimanzi. Musa ukuzitshonisa emanzini.
Emva koko bala izityalo ezincinci ezikhule ngokuqhelekileyo.
Ezintandathu kwezilishumi zimalunga namashumi amathandathu ekhulwini. Oko kukuxelela ukuba utyale ngokuxinene ngakumbi, usebenzise imbewu njengovavanyo kuphela, okanye uyitshintshe.
Ukuba iimbewu ezisibhozo kwezilishumi ziyahluma, oko kuyingaphi ekhulwini?
Impendulo ngamashumi asibhozo ekhulwini.
Qala uvavanyo lweembewu ezilishumi usebenzisa ipakethi endala. Bhala phantsi umhla nosuku oya kubala ngalo.

english.heading: Watch: Ten-Seed Germination Test
body: Count exactly ten seeds.
Place them in two rows of five.
Keep them on moist paper or cloth. Do not submerge them in water.
After some time, count again.
Here, six have germinated. Four have not. The total is still ten.
The germination rate is therefore sixty percent.
Check yourself. Did you count ten at the start, six germinated seeds and four ungerminated seeds at the end?

body.text: Bala iimbewu ezilishumi ncam.
Zibeke kwimigca emibini yeembewu ezintlanu.
Zigcine kwiphepha okanye ilaphu elimanzi. Musa ukuzitshonisa emanzini.
Emva kwexesha, bala kwakhona.
Apha, ezintandathu ziyahlumile. Ezine azihlumanga. Isixa sihlala silishumi.
Ke ngoko izinga lokuhluma lingamashumi amathandathu ekhulwini.
Zivavanye. Ingaba wabala eshumi ekuqaleni, iimbewu ezintandathu ezihlumileyo neembewu ezine ezingahlumanga ekugqibeleni?

english.heading: Share Seed with Its Information
body: A seed exchange is not a table of unknown packets.
A good exchange moves information with the seed.
It tells you what the seed is. Where it came from. When it was saved. And whether it has been tested.
This honesty strengthens the whole network.
What information would help you trust seed from another household?
Take one of your packets. Practise describing it before sharing it. Give the seed and its basic history together.

body.text: Ukutshintshisana ngembewu asililo itafile yamapakethi angaziwayo.
Ukutshintshisana okulungileyo kuhambisa ulwazi kunye nembewu.
Kuxelela ukuba imbewu yintoni. Ivela phi. Yalondolozwa nini. Nokuba iye yavavanywa na.
Oku kunyaniseka kuyomeleza uthungelwano lonke.
Ngoluphi ulwazi olunokukunceda uthembe imbewu evela komnye umzi?
Thatha enye yamapakethi akho. Zilolonge ukuyichaza phambi kokwabelana. Nika imbewu kunye nembali yayo esisiseko.

english.heading: Field Assignment
body: This task is small enough to finish. It is important enough to matter.
Build one working seed-storage container.
Put labelled paper packets inside a dry, sealed container.
Take a photograph of it.
Then name the crop whose seed you will save this season.
The photograph is evidence. The packet is a beginning.
What do you still need to finish this at home?
Write a short materials list. Choose a completion date.

Before sealing the container, check your work: the seed is completely dry; every packet has the crop, variety and date; the container is cool, dark and protected from moisture; and you selected several healthy parent plants.

body.text: Lo msebenzi mncinci ngokwaneleyo ukuba ugqitywe. Kodwa ubalulekile kakhulu.
Akha isikhongozeli esinye esisebenzayo sokugcina imbewu.
Beka amapakethi ephepha abhalwe amagama ngaphakathi kwisikhongozeli esomileyo, esivaliweyo.
Thatha ifoto yaso.
Emva koko chaza isityalo oya kulondoloza imbewu yaso kwesi sizini.
Ifoto yibungqina. Ipakethi yinto yokuqala.
Yintoni ongekayifumani yokugqiba oku ekhaya?
Bhala uluhlu olufutshane lweempahla. Khetha umhla wokugqiba.

Phambi kokuvala isikhongozeli, hlola umsebenzi wakho: imbewu yomile ngokupheleleyo; ipakethi nganye inesityalo, uhlobo nomhla; isikhongozeli sipholile, simnyama kwaye sikhuselekile ekufumeni; kwaye ukhethe izityalo zabazali ezininzi ezinempilo.

english.heading: Field Action
body: Select.
Process.
Protect.
Verify.
Those four actions carry a seed collection from this field into the next season.
Begin with one crop and do it well.
Which crop will you begin with?
Say it aloud. Then choose one action you will take next.
The next season is already inside the seed you choose today.

body.text: Khetha.
Lungisa.
Khusela.
Qinisekisa.
Ezo zenzo zine zithwala ingqokelela yembewu isuka kule ntsimi iye kwisizini elandelayo.
Qala ngesityalo esinye uyenze kakuhle.
Uya kuqala ngasiphi isityalo?
Khuphe igama laso ngokuvakalayo. Emva koko khetha isenzo esinye oya kusenza ngokulandelayo.
Isizini elandelayo sele ikwimbewu oyikhethayo namhlanje.
